fields.Address: 4650 Hwy 17 S, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Name: Duplin Winery
fields.Short Description: Taste your way through a family-owned North Carolina winery's lineup of sweet, fruit-forward Southern wines near Barefoot Landing. Tastings and food-pairing lessons make it a fun stop on a beach-day detour.

fields.Name: Southern Hops Brewing Company
fields.Short Description: House beers like Pop's Pilsner and Blackwater Porter are paired with Southern-inspired dishes in a full-service restaurant and bar. Outdoor dining, family-friendly games and live music make it an easy stop in Murrells Inlet.

fields.Address: 1120 St Joseph Rd, Little River, SC 29566
fields.Name: La Belle Amie Vineyard
fields.Short Description: A small Little River vineyard just north of Myrtle Beach, away from the Highway 17 traffic. Call or check online for current tasting hours before you drive out.

fields.Name: New South Brewing
fields.Short Description: One of South Carolina's longest-running breweries, known for its White Ale and Star Wars-themed beers and decor. Settle in at the taproom, and call or check the website for current hours.

fields.Address: 4924 Hwy 17 S, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Name: Crooked Hammock Brewery
fields.Short Description: A big backyard with hammocks, yard games and a waterside Tortuga Island bar makes this Barefoot Landing-area brewpub an easy place to linger. Pair house craft beer with pub-style food, and bring the dog.

fields.Address: 2004 Hwy 17 S, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Name: Bin 2004
fields.Short Description: A wine bar and tasting room pouring bottles from regions like Napa Valley, Italy and France. It's a relaxed spot for a glass after a day on the beach.

fields.Address: 5020 Carolina Forest Blvd, Myrtle Beach, SC 29579
fields.Name: South Coast Beer Project
fields.Short Description: Rotating local craft beers, Detroit-style pizza and wings come with pond views at this family-friendly Carolina Forest brewery. The outdoor beer garden has lawn games and a big screen for game day.

fields.Name: Yee-Haw Brewing at Ole Smoky Distillery
fields.Vibe: Moonshine, beer and live music at Broadway at the Beach
fields.Short Description: Combine craft beer, moonshine tastings and live entertainment in one waterfront stop at Broadway at the Beach. There's a beer garden and a full-service restaurant.

fields.Name: Winyah Bay Brewing Company
fields.Short Description: Brews like the Blueberry Wheat and White Boots Pineapple Ale come with views of Winyah Bay from the Georgetown waterfront. Southern seafood dishes and indoor and outdoor seating make it worth the drive south.

fields.Address: 819 N Kings Hwy, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: Grand Strand Brewing Company
fields.Short Description: Pours a rotating lineup of about a dozen beers inside a renovated downtown building with exposed brick, a patio and a big outdoor plaza. It's a short walk from the Boardwalk and SkyWheel, with a small menu of burgers and pretzels.

fields.Address: 505 9th Ave N, Unit A, Myrtle Beach, SC 29577
fields.Name: The Tasting Room on 9th
fields.Short Description: A relaxed wine bar serving curated wines, craft cocktails and international beers. It's a good spot for catching up with friends or trying something new.

fields.Name: Black Drum Brewing
fields.Vibe: Ocean views and about 40 Carolina taps
fields.Short Description: Pick from about 40 South and North Carolina beers on tap, with ocean views from the building. Smoked meats and fresh seafood pair with an outdoor beer garden and yard games.

fields.Name: Tidal Creek Brewhouse
fields.Vibe: Brewery, coffee shop and backyard hangout
fields.Short Description: Sip more than a dozen house-brewed beers, or grab a coffee, at this Market Common taproom with a big backyard, firepits and a dog park. Live music and events keep the patio busy.

fields.Address: 4922 Hwy 17 S, North Myrtle Beach, SC 29582
fields.Name: Carolina Vineyards Winery
fields.Short Description: A wine-tasting stop along Highway 17 in North Myrtle Beach. Call or check the website for current tasting hours before you go.
